feeds.title: Ceres Rural
feeds.description: From time to time, our experienced employees take a moment to reflect on recent work, policy news or industry trends. Read what they have to say. Ceres Rural offers you a full scope of experience-led farming consultancy, technical support and business management.

feeds.title: Rural Studio Blog
feeds.description: Explore the blog for articles featuring our research, designs and news from the institute. Auburn University Rural Studio is a design-build architecture program based in Hale County, Alabama. Our mission is to enable each participating student to cross the threshold of misconceived opinions to create/design/build and to allow students to put their educational values to work as citizens of a community.

feeds.title: The Daily Yonder
feeds.description: The Daily Yonder is the only national news organization for rural people and places. You won't find rural stories like these anywhere else. The Daily Yonder provides news, commentary, and analysis about and for rural America.

feeds.title: Sehgal Foundation Blog
feeds.description: Blogs by Sehgal Foundation speaks volume about rural development organization in India. We believe every person deserves to lead a more secure, prosperous, and dignified life. With that vision in mind, the S M Sehgal Foundation mission is to strengthen community-led development initiatives to achieve positive social, economic, and environmental change across rural India.

feeds.title: Rural Assembly Blog
feeds.description: For the latest news and resources that can help strengthen rural America. The Rural Assembly is a coalition of people and organizations across the country dedicated to building more opportunity and better policy for rural communities.

feeds.title: Blandin on Broadband
feeds.description: Find news and information on broadband use, policy, access, and trends, especially in rural Minnesota. Blandin on Broadband is maintained by the Broadband team members at the Blandin Foundation. Our goal is to share information that supports and promotes broadband access and use.

feeds.title: The Rural Blog
feeds.description: A digest of events, trends, issues, ideas and journalism from and about rural America, by the Institute for Rural Journalism and Community Issues, based at the University of Kentucky. This blog is about facts that we think will be useful to rural journalists, non-rural journalists who do rural stories, and others interested in rural issues.

feeds.title: Legal Ruralism Blog
feeds.description: The Legal Ruralism blog addresses several legal issues that affect the people living within rural areas of various states. Lisa R. Pruitt started the blog in 2007 to comment on intersection of law with the lives of rural folk.

feeds.title: Rural Health Information Hub
feeds.description: The RHIhub is your guide to improving health for rural residents. We provide access to current and reliable resources and tools to help you learn about rural health needs and work to address them. Get top news stories of interest to the rural health community, collected and shared by the Rural Health Information Hub.

feeds.title: Rural Vermont » From The Field Blog
feeds.description: Here you will find blog updates from Rural Vermont's Organizers. We are Vermont's farmers, farmworkers, neighbors and community members committed to supporting and cultivating an equitable and vibrant economy and community.

feeds.title: Decent Rural Living Initiative Blog
feeds.description: Decent Rural Living Initiative features blogs about topics like gender equality in farmers' groups, PPE innovation, and education in rural Indonesia. The Decent Rural Living Initiative is a pre-competitive collaboration by five leading palm oil producers to develop long term practical solutions that benefit rural workers in the palm oil industry, with an initial focus on Indonesia.

feeds.title: SRUC Rural Brexit Hub Blog
feeds.description: The blog aims to help farmers in Scotland and provide farm advisory service. SRUC's Rural Brexit Hub posts information on Brexit-related activities being undertaken across SRUC, including work by our researchers and SAC Consulting staff.

feeds.title: Raydient Rural
feeds.description: Celebrating rural living through the real stories and expert advice of people who live in the country. Rethink Rural celebrates the virtues of country living and helps those who are searching for a rural lifestyle find the answers they need: learn why so many people are choosing rural life, plus get practical information on how to buy land and shape it to suit your dreams.

feeds.title: Business Sisters
feeds.description: The Business Sisters blog posts feature information and reflections from local rural women entrepreneurs. Learn about the resilience of women in business! Business Sisters is a bilingual social enterprise dedicated to building happy, resilient rural communities by connecting women business owners so they can learn and thrive.

feeds.title: Hoptown Chronicle » The Rural Blog
feeds.description: The Rural Blog is a publication of the Institute for Rural Journalism and Community Issues based at the University of Kentucky. Hoptown Chronicle is an independent, nonprofit news outlet that explores what's working, what's not, and what's next in Hopkinsville's downtown district, where there are new signs of life and purpose following decades of decline from its heyday as the town's business and cultural center.
